interpretation: GPLv2 has no GPLv3-style express patent grant; GPLv3 section 11 does. The option to use a later GPL version does not retroactively bind an earlier GPLv2 distributor to GPLv3 patent-grant obligations. Determine actual selected license version and contributor/version scope before making a rights determination.

references.relevance: Defines choice when a work specifies or-any-later-version.
Explicitly rejects automatic retroactive GPLv3 patent grants for a GPLv2 distributor.
